```{ojs}
jmcSupport = d3.range(1, 6)

jmcJoint = {
  const strength = Math.abs(jmcControls.association);
  const matchedY = x => jmcControls.association >= 0 ? x : 6 - x;

  return jmcSupport.flatMap(y => jmcSupport.map(x => ({
    x,
    y,
    probability: (1 - strength) / 25 +
      (y === matchedY(x) ? strength / 5 : 0)
  })));
}

jmcMarginalX = jmcSupport.map(x => ({
  x,
  probability: d3.sum(jmcJoint.filter(cell => cell.x === x), cell => cell.probability)
}))

jmcMarginalY = jmcSupport.map(y => ({
  y,
  probability: d3.sum(jmcJoint.filter(cell => cell.y === y), cell => cell.probability)
}))

jmcSelectedYProbability = jmcMarginalY.find(row => row.y === jmcControls.y).probability

jmcConditionalX = jmcSupport.map(x => {
  const joint = jmcJoint.find(cell =>
    cell.x === x && cell.y === jmcControls.y
  ).probability;
  return {
    x,
    probability: joint / jmcSelectedYProbability
  };
})

jmcSelectedJoint = jmcJoint.find(cell =>
  cell.x === jmcControls.x && cell.y === jmcControls.y
).probability

jmcSelectedConditional = jmcConditionalX.find(row =>
  row.x === jmcControls.x
).probability

jmcMaximumJoint = d3.max(jmcJoint, cell => cell.probability)
```

```{ojs}
jmcJointPlot = Plot.plot({

jmcComparisonPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(500, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),

})
```

```{ojs}
jmcReadout = md`${tex`p_{X,Y}(${jmcControls.x},${jmcControls.y})
  =${jmcSelectedJoint.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  p_Y(${jmcControls.y})=${jmcSelectedYProbability.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  p_{X\mid Y}(${jmcControls.x}\mid${jmcControls.y})
  =\frac{${jmcSelectedJoint.toFixed(3)}}{${jmcSelectedYProbability.toFixed(3)}}
  =${jmcSelectedConditional.toFixed(3)}`}`

jmcConclusion = Math.abs(jmcControls.association) < 0.01
  ? html`At zero association every row has the same shape, so ${tex`p_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=p_X(x)`}: conditioning provides no new information.`
  : html`The highlighted row is the joint distribution restricted to ${tex`Y=${jmcControls.y}`}. Dividing that row by ${tex`p_Y(${jmcControls.y})`} rescales it to sum to one and produces the conditional distribution.`

html`<div class="jmc-figure-shell ojs-figure-shell">

      ${jmcJointPlot}

    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="jmc-legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
    <span><i class="jmc-joint-row"></i> Selected joint row ${tex`Y=${jmcControls.y}`}</span>
    <span><i class="jmc-marginal"></i> Marginal ${tex`p_X(x)`}</span>
    <span><i class="jmc-conditional"></i> Conditional ${tex`p_{X\mid Y}(x\mid ${jmcControls.y})`}</span>
    <span><i class="jmc-cell"></i> Inspected cell</span>
  </div>
  <div class="jmc-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">${jmcReadout}</div>
</div>

<style>
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the controls in a stable output cell beneath the reactive figure.
viewof jmcControls = {
  const dependenceForm = Inputs.form({
    association: Inputs.range([-1, 1], {
      value: 0.7,
      step: 0.1,
      label: "Association"
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const selectionForm = Inputs.form({
    y: Inputs.range([1, 5], {
      value: 4,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Condition on ${tex`Y=y`}`
    }),
    x: Inputs.range([1, 5], {
      value: 4,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Inspect ${tex`X=x`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Distribution controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Dependence</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Condition &amp; inspect</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(dependenceForm);
  columns[1].append(selectionForm);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...dependenceForm.value, ...selectionForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```
